envelope.description: persistReview, the one review persist helper

body.title: persistReview, the one review persist helper
body.summary: Add src/workflow/review/persist-review.ts: inspect, head conflict check, store the fix through updateContent with addresses [], record the review (a 'review' log entry with the full report via t2, then lifecycle.review with the report Reference), render the markdown; a failure raises ReviewPersistError naming the step. Test src/workflow/review/__tests__/persist-review.test.ts with a failure injected at each step.
acceptanceChecks: The steps run in the stated order and the lifecycle record comes before the markdown
A failure at each step names the step and a rerun repairs the state
The auto-fix passes addresses [] so open feedback stays open

tests.name: persist-review.test.ts: a failure at each step names the step and a rerun repairs the state
